initial_estimates: zero in the first episode; symbolic nonzero prior offset for repeated events
watermark: M_k=.5I+beta_k beta_k^T, beta_k iid N(0,.5I2), independent of physical noises
gains: saved constant common G and local K; all admitted innovations use the prior
outage_cap: symbolic B over 7..16, includes deadline timeouts and failed timely authentication, union count
consecutive_outage_cap: symbolic h over the same service opportunities

reference_fixture.purpose: minimal nonzero reference for covariance and mode retention; not a device specification

fault_information.A0: fixed original model-consistent FDI is a subcase, kept as previously frozen
fault_information.comparison_A_B_C: all classes share public model and the same permitted coded-packet observation stream, with no real-time verifier, receiver, local, or future-noise information
fault_information.history_current: abstract target-only past/current encoded observations, as in H/C; observation opportunity may coexist with an unavailable receiver update in the upper envelope
fault_information.additional_feedback: none; source sends raw measurements periodically without estimator or availability feedback
fault_information.physical_permissions: trusted local and healthy neighbor measurements, physical state, watermark secrets, and authentication secrets remain outside the fault information model

verification: all deadline-timely ideal verification, as integrity-only comparison
availability_information: periodic expected arrivals and trusted local deadline, effective loss is visible by update; no attribution of the cause by timeout alone
baseline_alarming: each inherited detector separately; only complete temporal or joint raw measurement windows, same fixed 5% event budget as G3
alarm_variants: statistical or ideal authentication failure (G3 convention)
statistical or any unavailable packet at deadline
sample_generation: none; frozen model covariance algebra and fixed scalar control-law fixtures
optimization: defender-side upper bounds on the full uncertainty class and exact fixed-mode identities
